summary: Backcountry skier triggered an avalanche in Silver Couloir on Buffalo Mountain and was swept ~2,000 ft down the slope out of sight of a companion, who began a transceiver search; skier deployed an avalanche airbag and activated a Garmin inReach; Summit County Rescue Group alerted 10:14 a.m., skied in on foot in high winds, placed the skier (believed mildly to moderately injured) in a toboggan and skied out; transported to hospital by ambulance
notes: Date: the opened advnture.com story says 'On Thursday, March 28' -- 2024-03-28 was a Thursday (weekday-verified; article last-updated ~2024-04-03, 'last week' consistent). The report notes the avalanche itself was not substantial -- the ~2,000-ft vertical drop carried the skier over half a kilometer. Dedupe: no Buffalo Mountain/Silver Couloir rows in DB; no Summit 2024-03-25-31 rows. | Summit Fire & EMS District page (parent-opened 2026-09-17) corroborates the same incident: avalanche on Buffalo Mountain dragged a skier 2,000 feet down the Silver Couloir.
